# Bay Greenery

> Licensed landscape contractor (CA License C-27 #1146610) based in Cupertino, California, serving residential and commercial clients across the South Bay and Peninsula. Owner-operated by Nathan, with a focus on thoughtful planning, careful construction, and dependable ongoing care.

Bay Greenery handles the full lifecycle of outdoor spaces — from initial landscape concept through installation, repair, and seasonal maintenance. Services span new construction (planting, irrigation, hardscape, lighting, retaining walls, sod, artificial turf, decomposed granite, drainage), corrective work on existing systems, routine and detailed maintenance, full-property cleanups, and standalone consultations for planning or second opinions.

## Services

- **Landscape Projects** — Installs across a wide range of landscape systems, functional and aesthetic. Solutions tailored to the property; projects of every scale.
- **Design to Build** — End-to-end landscape remodels. Concept development, planting, irrigation, and hardscape installation. Aesthetically compelling, functional, and built to last.
- **Repair Service** — Practical, effective fixes for landscape systems. Irrigation troubleshooting and repair, landscape feature repairs, corrective solutions.
- **Landscape Maintenance** — Customized maintenance programs that combine horticultural knowledge with attention to detail. Communicative, dependable, more than mow-and-blow.
- **Landscape Cleanup and Restoration** — Seasonal and one-time cleanups, landscape detailing, clean-slate clearouts for overgrown or neglected properties.
- **Consultations** — Planning and problem solving, professional second opinions, site evaluations.

## Service area

San Jose, the South Bay, the Peninsula, and the broader San Francisco Bay Area.
